notes.title: Hotfix 1.00.0028
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue with Focus test vocabulary generation (all words) when not a lot of words are unlocked (end of airport)
- Fixed minor tilemap / sprite issues in some locations

notes.title: Hotfix 1.00.0027
notes.notes:
- Fixed some issues with conjugation focus test generation
- Fixed romaji search issue in Dictionary (Kunrei Shiki romanization is now correctly recognized)
- Minor stability fixes
- Localization fixes

notes.title: Hotfix 1.00.0026
notes.notes:
- Fixed potential softlock issue occuring sometimes when exiting the game before taking the 鳥 in the Shizutani School
- Fixed typo in the book 公園の中の動物
- Minor localization fixes

notes.title: Hotfix 1.00.0025
notes.notes:
- Can replay questions of guards in castles
- Fixed issue with Focus Test questions randomization after replay
- Fixed issue with 降る in conjugation exercice for volitional form
- Improved SmallUI option by adding more screen ratio choices
- Localization fixes

notes.title: Hotfix 1.00.0024
notes.notes:
- Added an option to force the UI in 16:9 (beta)
- Improved the swap detection area of flick keyboard
- Steam achievements are now unlocked in real time (not when the game is closed)
- Fixed an issue with the conjugation exercise display during a lesson
- Fixed a missing hint in the Shizutani School quest line
- Fixed an issue making some empty disabled blocks spawning in sentence by blocks exercices
- Localization fixes

notes.title: Hotfix 1.00.0023
notes.notes:
- Added missing "+" key in the virtual keyboard layout
- Virtual keyboard layout should probably not appear anymore on Linux desktop devices
- Fixed the fact that the last voice dialogue was triggered when exiting a minigame
- Some localization fixes
